title: Weird license for DS and DS+ resource packs

posts.author: pawsplay
posts.body:
Both sets have this language:
This pack is licensed for use in RPG Makers and Visual Novel Maker only! Although editing is permitted for this pack, the character graphics (Pictures, Face) are not to be altered or edited in any way.
Click to expand...
Is it really those specific things, and why?

posts.author: ramza
posts.body:
It is, because the DS and DS+ packs were modifications of the RTP for the RPG Maker DS and DS+ engines, to work in newer rpg makers, so their terms are the same as the terms for any other RTP pack - you can use it in any rpg maker project (or VN maker).
The terms are always what they say. The wording is very specific for a reason, there is no workaround.

posts.author: pawsplay
posts.body: Generally, you can edit the faces and pictures. So the terms are different, and I'm wondering why.
